findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment:
The following canned foods on the shelf were observed to have dents:
1. Always save pineapple chunks was observed to have significant dent on the body.
2. Always save pear halves was observed to have significant dent on the body.
3. Always save fruit mix was observed to have significant dents on the body and along the seam (x4)
4. Bust black beans was observed to have significant dent on the body.

CORRECTED - The person-in-charge (PIC) was informed and the dented cans were removed from the shelf. Dented cans can have entry and harborage of Botulism, ensure canned foods with dents are removed from the shelf and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [PF]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment:
Rodent droppings were observed on and under the snack storage shelves. Food residue (popcorn) and gnawed packaging were also observed, including within a wall opening to the left of the snack shelves, indicating evidence of rodent activity.

The PIC was informed of these findings. The PIC stated that a pest control operator had recently serviced the facility and set traps; however, documentation of the most recent service was not available at the time of inspection.

The PIC was instructed to thoroughly clean and sanitize all affected areas, including on and under the shelves, to remove droppings and food residue. The PIC was also advised to maintain documentation of pest control services on-site. 

A follow-up inspection will be conducted on March 31, 2026 to verify that rodent activity has been addressed and to review pest control service records.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13. [PF]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:
1. Soil accumulation was observed on the lower air intake vents of the center cooler located along the left wall.
2. Soil accumulation was observed on the product display tray for bottled water in the center cooler along the left wall.

The PIC was informed. Ensure the surfaces mentioned above in the center cooler along the left wall side are cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Bare wood with a huge opening was observed behind the ice cream freezer. The inspector discussed having the opening closed for smooth and easy cleaning and to prevent hideouts for pests and rodents.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]
